comment: Dell Vostro 3520 (12th Gen Intel Core i5-1235U Alder Lake, Intel Iris Xe Graphics 8086:46a8, 80 EU). Uses SMBIOS MacBookPro16,2 (natively supported by Tahoe 25G342) with OpenCore base from VostroXe, Alder Lake CPUID spoofing, CryptexFixup (-crypt_force_avx), and optional Intel Iris Xe Metal 2 acceleration (pack intel-xe).

efi_build.comment: Base EFI starts from qemu_reference_efi (EFI/BOOT/BOOTx64.efi for non-Apple UEFI); opencore-vostro3520 overlays the Vostro 3520 ACPI, kexts, quirks and configs, then hao-opencore adds Darwin 27 kernel repairs, IntelCommpage and HaoExec.

cpu.why: Dell Vostro 3520 Core i5-1235U (2P+8E, 12 threads, AVX2, FMA, AES-NI). Spoofed as Comet Lake via OpenCore Cpuid1Data for XNU compatibility.
